create_graph_from_text: create a GTN graph from an array of text lines by writing to a temp file and loading with gtn.loadtxt
test_create_graph_from_text: test the create_graph_from_text function by passing an array of graph definition lines
review_create_graph_from_text: review the create_graph_from_text helper that writes text lines to a temp file and loads a GTN graph
refactor_create_graph_from_text: refactor create_graph_from_text to accept a file path directly instead of a text array
summarize_create_graph_from_text: summarize the create_graph_from_text function which creates a GTN graph from text line arrays
